name: ghost-from-the-past-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker backend for Ghost from the Past

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env local --local

GHOST_SECRET.description: Paste the secret from the **Ghost from the Past** setup page in Chrome (it was copied to your clipboard when you pressed Deploy). No setup page? Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32` and paste the same value into the extension's Options later.
